name: loki
description: Simple IOC and YARA scanner for detecting malware, backdoors, and suspicious artifacts

loki.description: IOC scanner using YARA rules, hash matching, filename patterns, and C2 detection
loki.usage:
loki -p C:\scan_target
loki --noprocscan
loki --intense
loki -l logfile.txt
loki --csv
loki --allreasons

loki-upgrader.description: Update Loki signatures and YARA rules from the official repository
